title: InsightTypeItem
description: A single supported Insight type entry. The `dataSchema` field describes only the Insight-specific input — it does not represent the full `POST /insights` request body.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Insight type. Maps to the `insightType` values used by existing Insight endpoints: `account`, `balance`, `identity`, `income`, `expense-ratio`.

supportMultipleUsers.description: Whether this Insight type supports multiple users in a single request.

name.description: Human-readable name for the Insight type.

description.description: Description of what the Insight type verifies.

dataSchema.description: Describes only the Insight-specific input data accepted by existing Insight endpoints for this type. Does not include transport-level fields such as `users` or `type`.
